title: The Eleven Acres
subtitle: 森林生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）
meta: 主题语境：森林生态（自然生态·森林与生态）　|　核心词汇：plant　|　正文 308 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① plant stands at the north end of the valley, where the road stops and the trees begin, and it has stood there since 1974, which is longer than most of the trees. Nobody in the village calls it anything but the plant. The men who work there say the same word and mean something else: to them the ② plant is the gate, the yard and the two sheds behind it, and everything that grows is somebody else's business.

Every spring the company ③ plants a field on the far side of the road, and every spring the village is invited to help. We put in ④ plants that are six inches high and mostly die by August, and the company photographs the ones that survive. My mother, who has counted for years, says the ⑤ plant material they use is the wrong kind for this soil, and that they know it.

What I did not understand until 2019 was that the trees were never the point. The ⑥ plant had applied to extend its yard by eleven acres, and the field we were planting was the eleven acres. The man who spoke most warmly at the meeting about children and ⑦ young plants turned out to be ⑧ a plant himself, an engineer sent to listen.

My mother said afterwards that she had known, because he used the word differently: he said ⑨ plant when he meant the machinery, not the trees, and no villager has ever done that. To us a plant is a thing with roots, and the forest is ⑩ the plant that matters.

The yard was extended in 2020. The field is now a car park, and the saplings my mother planted in 2019 are behind the fence, where nobody photographs them. She says the difference is simple: the company plants things it can move, and we plant things that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: C. n. 幼苗；秧苗；一株植物（young plants）
D. n.[U] 成套设备；机械装置（plant and machinery）
E. n. 厂房；厂区；全厂
F. 固定搭配：plant a field / plant trees 在……上种植；栽种
G. n. 卧底；被安插的人（a plant）
H. adj. 植物的；植物性的（plant material / plant life）

items.q: The plant stands at the north end of the valley
the plant is the gate, the yard and the two sheds
the company plants a field on the far side of the road
We put in plants that are six inches high
The plant had applied to extend its yard
turned out to be a plant himself
he said plant when he meant the machinery
the forest is the plant that matters

answers.why: the plant 指山谷北端的那座“工厂”，全村都这么叫它。
指“厂区”，在工人看来厂就是大门、院子和两间棚屋。
plant a field 意为“种一片地”，公司每年春天在路那边种一片。
plants 意为“幼苗、秧苗”，我们栽下的苗只有六英寸高，多半活不过八月。
plant material 意为“植物材料、植物性材料”，此处 plant 作形容词。
the plant 指“那家工厂”，它申请把厂区再扩十一英亩。
young plants 意为“幼苗”，会上那个人大谈孩子和幼苗。
a plant 意为“卧底、被安插的人”，说他是公司派来听会的一名工程师。
plant 意为“成套设备、机械装置”，他说这个词时指的是机器而不是树。
a plant 意为“植物”，对我们来说植物是有根的东西，森林才是要紧的植物。
